system.description:
The mage plants a plausible impulse or minor belief in a target’s mind, nudging them toward a choice they could believably have made themselves. Rank 3 influences another’s thoughts and emotions directly. Overt or implausible commands strain belief and risk Paradox or resistance.

Dice Pool: Manipulation + Subterfuge (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Mind 3; mechanics paraphrased.
